Metadata.title: MTG Creator
Metadata.description: Build, validate and share your Magic: The Gathering Commander decks, in English and French.

HomePage.title: Build your Commander decks
HomePage.subtitle: Search cards, build your deck around your commander and check that it follows the rules as you go.

search.title: Fast search
search.description: Find any card by name, even with a typo, and filter by color, type or cost.

rules.title: Commander rules checked
rules.description: 100 cards, singleton, color identity, banned cards and Game Changers: errors show up while you build.

stats.title: Deck statistics
stats.description: Mana curve, colors, card types, lands and total price in euros or dollars.

share.title: Import, export and sharing
share.description: Import a list from Moxfield, Archidekt or MTG Arena, export yours and share it with a simple link.

SignUpPage.title: Create an account
SignUpPage.description: Save your decks and find them on all your devices.

ResetPasswordPage.description: Choose your new password. Your other devices will be signed out.

resetPassword.body: You asked to change the password of your MTG Creator account. The link is valid for one hour.
resetPassword.ignore: If you did not make this request, ignore this email: your password stays the same.

accountExists.body: Someone just asked to create an MTG Creator account with this address, but it already belongs to an account. Just sign in; if you forgot your password, you can reset it from the sign-in page.
